$doc: HALLOWEEN-2022 sound set: the sounds of the EFFECTS theme `halloween-2022` (video-creation/assets/effects/library.json, themes.halloween-2022), the look of Mike's 2022 'Bear Markets' video (CodeMonkey 044, main-sequence.mp4, studied 0:00-1:50 ONLY). In that window the theme's devices fired almost no sound of their own: the word pops, the two After Effects montages, the camera shakes and the Finzar punches were all SILENT (music only); the one device sound is woosh9 under the subscribe / like / bell button. The pumpkin stinger's baked sound belongs to the transitions library (scary-6), the evil-eye clip's eerie audio is b-roll audio, neither is catalogued here. Every row carries `device` (the effects device id it fires with). The time-ordered map of the source is video-creation/assets/effects/themes/halloween-2022/CUE-SHEET.md.
$schema_note: Same shape as ../kinetic-text/library.json. `trigger` = the on-screen event the sound was cut to in the source (the field to pick by). `reference_cues_main_sequence` = seconds in Bear Markets main-sequence.mp4 (0:00-1:50 only). `attack_sec` = seconds from file start to the loudest sample (filled by sfx_catalog.py build). `device` = the effects-library device id(s) the sound belongs to.
